subject: board.py: optional board.key_file gate (?key= sets an HttpOnly cookie, 401 otherwise, /healthz always open, POST gated too); actl board serves the project root
objective: Design docs/design/project-runnable-entries.md (D-071) C9, section 6, section 8 V14, acceptance row C9, follow-up row 5. Entry name actl (D-072); 'actl board' is already wired by #159 (board/board.py with AC_ROOT = project), so this ticket changes board/board.py and its tests only. (1) board.py reads board.key_file from the project's board/config.json (through event.config(root()) like 'port'). Key absent or null -> every behaviour byte for byte as today (whole existing test_board suite). (2) Key set: the path is relative to the project root (absolute allowed); the key is the file's first line stripped of whitespace. File missing or first line empty -> the board refuses to start: one stderr line containing 'board: key_file', the path and 'missing or empty', rc 2, no port line (a configured gate must not fall open, section 5.5). (3) With a key, for every method (GET and the existing POST) and every path except exactly /healthz: if the query carries key=<v> and hmac.compare_digest(v, key) -> 302, Location = the same path with the key parameter removed and every other parameter kept (no query -> bare path), header Set-Cookie: ac_board_key=<v>; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict, empty body; else if the request's ac_board_key cookie compare_digest-equals the key -> served as today; else 401 with an empty body and no WWW-Authenticate. A wrong ?key= is 401 and sets no cookie. /healthz (after the existing rstrip of a trailing slash) is 200 as today and never requires the key - it is the portal's liveness probe. (4) The log line stays path-only (today's log_message already prints urlparse(path).path); the key must never appear on stderr. (5) Bind stays 127.0.0.1 (board.py:1210), no bind key, --port unchanged, port 0 for tests (test_board.py:29). (6) Not here: proxy headers, sessions, key rotation, a UI for the key; T's portal decides whether to use the key (D-071 original words).
acceptance: A1 unchanged without a key (tests/test_board.py): every existing test_board case green with Ran count equal to base plus the new cases; a sandbox whose config has "board": {} -> GET / 200 with no Set-Cookie header and GET /healthz 200.

A2 V14 flow (tests/test_board.py BoardUp, config_extra board.key_file = 'board/key.txt', the test writes 'k-secret\nsecond line ignored\n'; a urllib opener that does not follow redirects): GET / -> 401 and body b''; GET /api/state -> 401; GET /t/1 -> 401; GET /healthz -> 200 and JSON {"ok": true}; GET /?key=k-secret -> 302, Location == '/', Set-Cookie contains 'ac_board_key=k-secret', 'HttpOnly' and 'Path=/'; GET / with header 'Cookie: ac_board_key=k-secret' -> 200 and the HTML contains the sandbox ticket subject the test wrote; GET /t/1?key=k-secret&x=1 -> 302 Location == '/t/1?x=1'; GET /?key=wrong -> 401 and no Set-Cookie; GET / with 'Cookie: ac_board_key=wrong' -> 401. The expected key comes from the test's own file write.

A3 POST gated (tests/test_board.py): the existing POST route (board.py ~1182) without a cookie -> 401 and the sandbox's answers file line count before == after; with the cookie -> the existing POST case's assertions hold unchanged.

A4 refuse to start (tests/test_board.py): key_file configured but absent -> the process exits within 20 s with rc 2, stderr contains 'key_file' and 'board/key.txt', and no 'http://127.0.0.1:' line was printed; the same with a file whose first line is empty.

A5 static + log + actl (tests/test_board.py): grep -c compare_digest board/board.py >= 1 (design acceptance C9); the stderr captured during A2 contains '/t/1' and does not contain 'k-secret'; 'sh $AC_HOME/bin/actl board --port 0' with cwd = sandbox prints the port line within 20 s and GET /healthz is 200 (stopped through the Popen handle as the existing _stop does).

verify.notes: Verifier edge cases for the board.key_file gate (#165), beside the worker's A1-A5 in tests/test_board.py: cookie among other cookies (and x_ac_board_key is not it), key file with spaces + CRLF, /healthz/ open vs /HEALTHZ and /healthz/x 401, absolute key_file (present and missing), key with '=' and '%' round-tripped through the Set-Cookie pair, /board.css and /board.js gated, 401 without WWW-Authenticate, 302 Location keeping other params (order kept) and Set-Cookie attributes exactly Path=/, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, POST with ?key= -> 302 and no answers file, key_file null -> ungated. Expected codes/headers come from the ticket objective; keys from the file each test writes. Uses http.client (no redirect following) and the harness Sandbox only (not BoardUp), board stderr to a file, stopped via its Popen handle. On base 10 of 11 red; test_a_null_key_file_is_the_ungated_board is green on base by design (null key = today's behaviour). The two refuse-to-start cases wait up to 20 s each on base before failing.

test_plan: Worker, foreground: timeout 590 python3 -m unittest tests.test_board tests.test_actl; report Ran/OK verbatim with the base Ran count of tests.test_board for A1. Worker writes A1-A5 in tests/test_board.py (reuse BoardUp.serve/_stop/get; add a no-redirect opener and a header-returning get). Verifier (needs_verifier true, interface_fixed true: paths, codes, cookie name and header text are pinned above) writes tests/test_board_cases.py (new, not in worker scope) in parallel: at least a Cookie header carrying other cookies around ac_board_key, a key file with trailing spaces and CRLF, '/healthz/' (open, rstrip) versus '/HEALTHZ' (401), an absolute key_file path, a key containing '=' and '%', and '/board.css' / '/board.js' gated like '/'. Mutations (not measured by opener): m1 compare_digest replaced by '==' -> A5 red; m2 /healthz gated -> A2 red; m3 a missing key file treated as 'no key' -> A4 red; m4 POST not gated -> A3 red; m5 cookie set on a wrong ?key= -> A2 red. Container runs as uid 0: no chmod-based unreadable-file cases (root reads them); use a missing file or invalid JSON instead. hard_block.patterns forbids the four process-signal spellings in added tests/** lines: never stop a child that way in a test; stop a served board only through the Popen handle as tests/test_board.py _stop does today; timeouts belong to subprocess.run(timeout=) inside scripts/.
